svg.title: Local workflow scripts
svg.desc: make clone reads local/repo.yaml and clones each repository into the parent folder. make sync runs sync_git.sh, which pulls each repository fast forward only, runs make sync in it, then poetry lock and install in local mode or poetry update in git mode. make local runs deploy.sh local, which starts make local in every package and module in the background. make push runs push_git.sh, which syncs, commits everything and pushes each repository.
